title: Overview
description: Live dashboard for an SSH honeypot, a decoy server that lets attackers in and records what they do: attack volume, top origins, and a world map.

title: Pulse
description: When attacks on the honeypot happen: by hour, by weekday, and day by day over the last month.

title: Sessions
description: Recorded attacker sessions on the honeypot: the commands they typed, the logins they tried, and the software they connected with.

title: Credentials
description: The usernames and passwords attackers try most often against the honeypot.

title: Origins
description: Where attacks on the honeypot come from: countries, cities and networks.

title: Payloads
description: Files attackers left on the honeypot, where they were hosted, and the relay attempts the honeypot blocked.
